title: RSAWIT International Marathon 2026 Review: Sarawak's Sibu Town Square Race
seo_title: RSAWIT Marathon 2026 Review | Sibu Sarawak Malaysia Race
meta_description: The RSAWIT International Marathon 2026: November 22 at Sibu Town Square, Sarawak. Full and half marathon with registration open — a Sarawak road race reviewed.
dek: Set for 22 November 2026 at Dataran Tun Tuanku Bujang (Sibu Town Square) in Sarawak, this marathon offers full and half distances with registration open. A Borneo road race in one of Malaysia's most distinctive states.
verdict: The RSAWIT International Marathon takes place at Sibu Town Square in Sarawak — Malaysian Borneo's third-largest city, known for its Foochow Chinese heritage and as the gateway to the Rajang River. Two distances (42K, 21K) with registration open. Sibu is flat, built on the Rajang floodplain, which means a fast course profile — though November humidity on Borneo's coast is always a factor. For runners wanting a Sarawak marathon outside the Kuching mainstream, this is a bookable option.

sections.heading: Sibu: Sarawak's Riverside Hub
paragraphs: Sibu is a working river-port city on the Rajang — Sarawak's longest river — with a distinctive Foochow Chinese cultural identity. [1] Sibu Town Square provides a central, accessible start/finish precinct in a city that's predominantly flat. November is the onset of Sarawak's landas (monsoon) season, with higher rainfall probability.

sections.heading: Should You Run It?
paragraphs: If you want a Sarawak marathon with open registration and a flat course profile, the RSAWIT International Marathon is worth considering. The 2026 edition is set for 22 November at Sibu Town Square. [1]

faqs.question: When is the RSAWIT Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: 22 November 2026 at Sibu Town Square, Sarawak, Malaysia. [1]
